card.name: Space after cross-reference before next section
card.fires_on: The space right after a closing cross-reference such as [see ... (5.1)] . that ends a warnings subsection, just before the next numbered heading. Also weakly on a few word-internal pieces like syndrom|ic and Ray|na|ud, and on 'reports' after spontaneous.

modes.label: Gap before next section
modes.description: Blank space after a bracketed 'see ...' cross-reference and period, right before the next numbered section heading.

modes.label: Partway through medical words
modes.description: Middle pieces of longer medical words such as syndromic or Raynaud's.

modes.label: Spontaneous reports
modes.description: The word reports after spontaneous or observational studies in postmarketing text.
modes.example: Spontaneous<< reports>> of serotonin syndrome including fatal cases

card.plain: It fires on the small gap where one warnings subsection ends and the next numbered one begins.
